LanguageData.QJ_UnfinishedWorkWaiting: this bill's unfinished item is waiting to be resumed
LanguageData.QJ_FinisherSkillTip: Only workers at or above this skill level are allowed to finish the work. Other eligible workers may do the earlier crafting.
LanguageData.QJ_AutoBestTip: Checked: Reserve finishing for the colony's top-ranked workers, comparing expected quality from skill, Inspired Creativity, specialist roles and supported quality bonuses. Your manual skill requirement is ignored. Away, downed or busy workers still count; if no top-ranked worker can finish on this map, the work waits.\n\nUnchecked: Any eligible worker meeting your manual skill requirement and other finisher requirements may finish.
LanguageData.QJ_MigrationBody: Quality Jobs found {0} existing quality bill(s). They have been left unmanaged so they can continue with their current behavior. Shared unfinished work remains available either way.
LanguageData.QJ_MigrationEnableExisting: Enable Quality Jobs on existing bills for quality items?
LanguageData.QJ_MigrationEnableExistingTip: Checked: Existing bills use Quality Jobs with Choose the best finisher automatically enabled. The best eligible worker in the colony performs the finishing touch; temporarily unavailable workers still count. Inspiration and production-specialist requirements are disabled, and low-quality results are not retried.\n\nUnchecked: Existing bills keep vanilla completion behavior. Sharing unfinished work is unaffected.
LanguageData.QJ_StockCapTooltip: Limits new work on this product on each map. All unfinished items of this product on a map count together across bills and benches, but only Quality Jobs-managed bills stop starting new items when the cap is reached.\n\nExisting items can still be resumed or finished. 0 means unlimited. Changing this value changes the product's cap for every bill, with each map counted separately.
LanguageData.QJ_StatusQueueTip: Counts include this product's tracked unfinished items across all bills and benches on this map.\n\nUnfinished: items in the sharing pool that any allowed crafter may continue. Waiting: paused items that need a qualifying finisher. Finishing: items assigned to a finisher.
LanguageData.QJ_StatusFinishersTip: Workers on this map who currently qualify to perform the finishing touch, best candidate first. A worker qualifies when they can perform the required work type and meet the finisher requirements above. In a bill panel, this list uses the selected bill's requirements; other bills making the same product may use different requirements.\n\nDowned workers, workers in a mental state, and workers away from this map do not count.
LanguageData.QJ_StatusStalled: No finisher meets this bill's requirements.
LanguageData.QJ_StatusStalledTip: No worker currently meets this bill's finisher requirements. The queue counts cover all bills making this product on this map; other bills may use different requirements.\n\nCheck the finisher skill requirement, the inspiration and specialist requirements, and whether the intended finisher can perform the work type and is on this map. A full stock cap may also block new items from being started.
LanguageData.QJ_StatusStalledConstruction: No eligible finisher — build is stalled
LanguageData.QJ_StatusStalledConstructionTip: This building is paused waiting for a finishing touch, but no worker currently qualifies, so it will not complete.\n\nCheck the finisher skill requirement, the inspiration and specialist requirements, and whether the intended builder can perform Construction and is on this map.
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsManageNewBillsTip: Sets the management default for new quality bills and existing bills that still follow this default. Checked: Quality Jobs manages those bills using the defaults in this column. A bill's own Manage this bill setting overrides this default.\n\nUnchecked: Those bills finish normally. Turning this off also releases waiting items from affected bills so they can finish without meeting Quality Jobs requirements.
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsManageNewConstructionTip: Checked: New quality-producing buildings are managed automatically using the options in this column. Individual buildings can be configured or cleared with the Quality Job button.\n\nUnchecked: New buildings use vanilla behavior unless enabled individually.
LanguageData.QJ_RequireInspiredTip: Checked: Only a colonist with Inspired Creativity may perform the finishing touch; other workers may do the earlier work. The inspiration is consumed on completion, as in vanilla.\n\nUnchecked: Inspired Creativity is not required.
LanguageData.QJ_RequireSpecialistTip: Checked: Only a colonist whose Ideology role grants a production quality bonus may perform the finishing touch; other workers may do the earlier work.\n\nUnchecked: A production-specialist role is not required.
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsFinisherSkillTip: Only workers at or above this skill level may perform the finishing touch; other eligible workers may do the earlier work.\n\nWhen Choose the best finisher automatically is checked, this value is kept as the manual default but is not used.
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsShareWorkTip: Allows other eligible workers to resume ordinary unfinished work. Turning this off keeps that work with its original crafter.\n\nManaged bills can still hand work to a qualifying finisher; turn off Manage this bill to remove that bill's finishing requirements.
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsHighPriorityFinishTip: Checked: A worker chosen to finish an item takes that job the next time they look for work, before every other kind of work except firefighting, medical care, rescuing and bed rest. Their current job is not interrupted.\n\nUnchecked: The finish job is the first job within its work type, but work types the worker ranks higher still come first.
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsAllowRobotPreparation: Allow mechs and robots to work on quality jobs
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsAllowRobotPreparationTip: Allow mechs and supported robots to work on managed crafting and construction jobs. Turn this off to reserve that work and its skill experience for colonists. This also stops their current work on managed jobs. Eligible mechs and robots can still finish jobs assigned by Quality Jobs. Ordinary unmanaged jobs are unaffected.
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsDefaultCapTip: Sets the default unfinished-item cap for each product, with each map counted separately. All unfinished items of a product on a map count together across bills and benches, but only Quality Jobs-managed bills stop starting new items when the cap is reached.\n\nExisting items can still be resumed or finished. 0 means unlimited. A product's stock-cap setting overrides this default for every bill producing that product.
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsShowToolbarButtonTip: Adds a button beside the view toggles in the lower right corner of the screen. The button opens the Quality Jobs settings.
LanguageData.QJ_ToolbarButtonTip: Open Quality Jobs options and help.
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsEnabledNote: The toggle applies to the loaded save. Disabling restores all items to vanilla and discards this save's Quality Jobs configuration.\n\nIf the mod stays installed, it re-activates with default settings the next time the save is loaded. Disable is meant as preparation for removing the mod.
LanguageData.QJ_DisableWarning:
Disabling restores all set-aside items to vanilla ownership and permanently discards Quality Jobs configuration for this save (bill conditions, stock caps). Saves made afterwards contain no trace of the mod, so this is the clean way to prepare for uninstalling.

Finish replacement buildings first to retain their saved bed settings and paint. Once the original has been deconstructed, those settings need Quality Jobs until the replacement is complete.

Note: if you keep the mod installed, it will re-activate with default settings the next time you load this save.

Disable Quality Jobs?
LanguageData.QJ_NoGameLoaded: Load a save to change per-save behavior.
LanguageData.QJ_GizmoRebuildDesc: Choose a target quality and builder requirements for this completed building. Start rebuilding to deconstruct and replace it until the target is reached.
LanguageData.QJ_RebuildNote: Choose a target quality to start. Buildings below it will be deconstructed and rebuilt, using materials and becoming unavailable during the work. Buildings already meeting the target are kept.
LanguageData.QJ_NoRebuildNeeded: No eligible buildings need rebuilding. Buildings must be below the target, available to construct, and free of other deconstruction or reinstall orders.
LanguageData.QJ_GizmoManageDesc: Manage this construction with Quality Jobs: pause completion until a qualifying builder exists, and optionally rebuild until a target quality is rolled.\n\nLeft-click toggles it on or off. Enabling applies your construction defaults. Right-click configures it.
LanguageData.QJ_RetriedUntilTip: The build is deconstructed and rebuilt until it rolls the selected quality or better, except when No retries is selected.\n\nSome materials are lost on each retry.
LanguageData.QJ_BillTargetQualityTip: For Do X times, a below-target item is kept but does not reduce the remaining count. Further attempts use more materials. Any accepts every result.\n\nFor Do until you have X, set the normal bill's quality range instead. This setting does not affect Do forever.
LanguageData.QJ_CompatibilityQualityBuilder: QualityBuilder also controls builders and construction retries. Its rules can conflict with Quality Jobs.
LanguageData.QJ_CompatibilityNoJobAuthors: No Job Authors can resume quality-reserved work outside Quality Jobs when its force-finish or Achtung compatibility options are enabled.
LanguageData.QJ_CompatibilityFinishIt: Finish it! can fail when used on unfinished work that Quality Jobs has detached from its bill.
LanguageData.QJ_CompatibilitySharingAdvice: Turning off unfinished-work sharing does not eliminate all of these conflicts.
LanguageData.QJ_WelcomeBody: Quality Jobs lets eligible workers share the work on an item or building. Only a worker who meets the requirements you set may finish it, because the finisher determines quality. It works for crafting bills and construction.
LanguageData.QJ_WelcomeFind: Open the Quality Jobs settings with this button beside the view toggles in the lower right corner of the screen. The bill window for a quality item has a Quality Jobs section, and a selected blueprint or frame of a quality building has a Quality Job button.
